subject: Initial org provisioning plan & access matrix for Greenline Health
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff: Greenline Health - initial provisioning details

Hi team,

Putting this handoff in writing so implementation has everything to start org/tenant setup. Greenline (contact Samira/Karolina) verbally agreed to the SOW and wants a low-lift first milestone to get a PoC infra tenant. Key items below — attachments include the signed SOW and the customer-provided initial requirements sheet.

Quick summary:
- Account: Greenline Health (US, healthcare SaaS)
- Deal: DL-12987 — committed Dedicated q1 capacity, start date target: 2026-12-01
- Primary contacts: Samira Khan (technical PM) and Luis Ortega (security)

Requested initial deliverables from Redwood:
1) Create org/tenant and two projects: "prod-greenline" and "test-greenline"
2) Provision one API key scoped for test environment and one service principal for CI (customer asked for guidance on rotation cadence)
3) Invite 6 users mapped to roles (list in attachment)
4) Provide RBAC matrix & short runbook for key rotation and audit logs

Files attached: Greenline_Initial_Reqs.xlsx, SOW-DL12987-v1.pdf

Next best step: Olga — can you confirm a provisioning plan and estimated ETA for the first cut? Karthik, please advise if you want to scope a 2-hour kickoff with the customer.

Thanks,
Dev
Sales - Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Greenline Health - initial provisioning details

Thanks for the handoff, Dev — captured. I reviewed the attachments and sketched an initial access matrix and phased rollout that should keep the demo/PoC isolated from prod. Below is the plan I propose — please share with Samira to validate.

Phase 0 (pre-provision checks) — ETA: 1 business day
- Verify legal/KYC flags (Sales confirms no additional compliance docs)
- Confirm list of invitee emails and required roles (Dev: can you ask Samira to confirm the list in the attached sheet by EOD?)

Phase 1 (test environment) — ETA: 2 business days after Phase 0
- Create org: greenline-health-redwood
- Projects: test-greenline (default), demo-greenline (will host short PoC)
- API keys: create scoped Test API key (expires 90 days) — NOTE: we do NOT email secrets; we'll create the key in the console and share a secure DocuSign link for retrieval.
- Roles & invites: Invite 4 testers (role: Developer), 1 PM (role: Project Admin), 1 Security Viewer
- RBAC: pre-defined roles (Project Admin, Developer, Viewer) — I attached the access matrix tab in the sheet.

Phase 2 (prod readiness) — ETA: aligned with Karthik + security review
- Provision prod-greenline project behind dedicated capacity pools per SOW
- Create service principal for CI with scoped permissions, advise on rotation cadence (recommended 30/60 days)
- Enable audit log forwarding to customer S3/KMS (Luis to confirm bucket topology)

Action items:
- Dev: confirm Samira will provide final invite list and confirm whether they want SSO (Okta) onboarded during Phase 1 or later.
- Karthik: propose 60-minute kickoff slot for Thurs or Fri to lock the runbook and test users.
- Olga (me): will draft provisioning runbook, create the test API key, and post links to the secure share.

I will not create any prod keys until we get security sign-off from Luis.

Olga Petrov
Principal Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>; Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Greenline Health - initial provisioning details

On Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 10:22 AM PDT, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com> wrote:
> I will draft provisioning runbook, create the test API key, and post links to the secure share.

Thanks, Olga — sounds good. I can take the kickoff and propose Thursday 2026-11-18 10:00 AM PT. Agenda: 1) Confirm invite list & roles, 2) Walk through test key retrieval flow, 3) Discuss SSO and audit log endpoints, 4) Next steps to move prod provisioning.

One operational note: for the CI service principal we'll follow least-privilege: token issue scope limited to project:demo-greenline and only token-create/delete actions. If Greenline prefers long-lived keys for CI, we should push back and recommend ephemeral tokens + Vault integration.

I'll block 60 minutes on the calendar tentatively; Dev, can you confirm Samira/Luis for the slot?

Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>; Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Greenline Health - initial provisioning details

Thanks all — this looks great. Confirming the invite list is included in the attached spreadsheet (finalized). We prefer to postpone Okta SSO to Phase 2; for now please provision the test API key and invite the 6 users.

A couple of asks from our security team:
- Luis would like audit logs forwarded to our S3 bucket: s3://glh-prod-logs (we will provide IAM role details during kickoff)
- CI service account: we'll accept short-lived creds and integrate with our Vault after PoC.

We can take the 11/18 10:00 AM PT kickoff. Please send a calendar invite with dial-in and the Doc link.

Appreciate the clarity — Samira
Technical Program Manager
Greenline Health
